concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- AI in DevOps is not the future it is the present — teams using AI ship 2 times faster
- Copilot explains code writes tests and suggests security fixes — use it for everything
- AI monitoring uses anomaly detection to find patterns in logs humans miss completely
- Every prompt is an investment — save your best DevOps prompts in a personal library
- AI plus DevOps skills together is the rarest and highest-paying combination in 2024 and 2025
